name: Issue 11378: the 3rd Runeblade cast transforms the next Runeblade into Surging Slash
contract: Surging Slash 705579 reads 'Every 3rd cast of Runeblade now transforms your next Runeblade within $572358d
into Surging Slash' (803736), and its buff 572358 (StackAmount 3) reads 'At 3 stacks, Runeblade transforms into
Surging Slash.' Expected: after 1 and 2 Runeblade casts the Runeblade button still stands for itself; at 3
stacks it is replaced by 803736, which is known only while the replacement lasts; casting 803736 uses the buff
up (the transform is for the 'next' Runeblade), so the stacks return to 0, Runeblade stands for itself again
